annotations.title: Audit an X account — is the following real?

description: Rokha's account auditor: give it any X @handle and get an organic-ness audit — 0–100 score, ORGANIC/MIXED/SMOKE verdict, and the promotional-worth anchor in X-algorithm engagement units (reply 13.5 · quote 1.5 · repost 1.0 · like 0.5). Hard metrics from X's own numbers: engagement rate vs follower count, reply share (the hardest signal to buy), engagement variance across posts (bought engagement is flat), account age vs follower velocity. `deep: true` (the Lab) also returns a bounded reply_sample for judging reply QUALITY — generic bot-isms vs real human reaction. Honest scope: declared limits on what a public-API sample can prove. Signed in: one free audit a day, then $0.02 a call in packs of 50 (signed out it answers with the price); the Lab runs its own daily lane. Returns `result_url`, the link to this audit's full card.

deep.description: also pull the reply sample for a quality read (the Lab)

handle.description: the X handle to audit, with or without the @
